items.scenario: Your own customers owe you a lot of money and have not paid, so you cannot pay your suppliers either. The supplier is following up. You have a long-standing relationship with this supplier.
items.reply: customers ka paisa atka hua hai abhi, isliye thoda cash problem chal raha hai. jaise hi aata hai clear karenge

items.scenario: Your company requires all supplier bills to be uploaded to a vendor portal. This one is not showing up there. The supplier says they sent it by email. The bill is about three weeks overdue.
items.reply: mail mila tha but portal pe invoice nahi dikh raha. waha upload kar do pls

items.scenario: Two of the cartons in the last delivery arrived crushed and you had to reject them. Nobody has sent you a corrected bill. The supplier is asking for full payment. The bill is about three weeks overdue.
items.reply: 2 cartons damaged aaye the aur reject kiye the, revised bill abhi tak nahi mila

items.scenario: The rate on the bill is higher than what was agreed in the purchase order. The supplier is chasing payment.
items.reply: invoice ka rate PO se match nahi kar raha, ek baar correct karke bhejo

items.scenario: This is a small supplier and you have bigger payments to worry about this month. You are not planning to pay them yet. They have messaged you again. You have a long-standing relationship with this supplier.
items.reply: abhi kuch urgent payments hain pehle woh clear karne hain. iska thoda time lagega

items.scenario: Diwali is coming and your office will be shut for a week. You plan to clear pending bills after reopening. The supplier is asking. You have a long-standing relationship with this supplier.
items.reply: Diwali holidays ke baad office khulega, uske baad payment side dekh lenge

items.scenario: Business has been very slow for several months and you honestly do not have the cash right now. The supplier is asking for payment.
items.reply: business kaafi slow hai bhai, abhi genuinely cash nahi hai

items.scenario: You have been putting off this supplier for a while. They have now sent a firmer message mentioning the agreed payment terms. The bill is more than three months overdue.
items.reply: haan message dekh liya. thoda delay ho gaya hai, payment ka dekh raha hu
